start.title: La Voix d'En Haut
start.text:
Une voix remplit le ciel.
« Noé — construis une arche. Un déluge arrive. »

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The voice fades. But the weight in your chest remains.
[TODO:fr] Genesis 6:22 — Noah did everything just as God commanded him.
[TODO:fr] No answer comes. Only the command remains.

mockery.title: Voix de la Foule
mockery.text:
Les villageois se rassemblent, riant.
« Un bateau ? Ici ? Tu es fou, vieil homme. »

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Your words only feed their mockery.
[TODO:fr] Hebrews 11:7 — By faith Noah kept building the ark, despite the world's mockery.
[TODO:fr] They turn their backs. You are alone in faith.

building.title: Cyprès et Goudron
building.text:
Des années de sueur. Le bois se fend. Le goudron scelle.
Ton dos te fait mal, mais l'arche s'élève.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Rest a while, the work is endless
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Doubt creeps in with the silence.
[TODO:fr] Genesis 6:14-16 — Noah built the ark of cypress wood exactly as God instructed.

ark_done.title: Elle Est Achevée
ark_done.text:
L'arche te domine.
Ta famille se rassemble, silencieuse devant le bois.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Pride poisons the work. You catch yourself.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Thank God for the strength given
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis 6:9 — Noah walked with God and gave Him thanks for every step.

animals.title: Deux par Deux
animals.text:
Les créatures viennent de toutes les terres.
Des lions à côté d'agneaux. Des aigles à tes pieds.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Fear blinds you. God sent every one.
[TODO:fr] Genesis 7:8-9 — The animals came to Noah two by two, and he received them.

boarding.title: La Porte se Ferme
boarding.text:
Ta famille est à l'intérieur. Les animaux s'installent.
Dieu Lui-même ferme la porte.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Run back out to warn them again
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The door is sealed. The choice has been made.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Hold your wife's hand and wait
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis 7:16 — The Lord Himself shut the door of the ark behind Noah.

storm.title: Les Cieux s'Ouvrent
storm.text:
La pluie s'abat comme jamais auparavant.
Les profondeurs éclatent. Le monde se noie.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The sound swallows your cry.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Trust that God is just and merciful
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis 7:23 — Noah trusted God as the flood covered the earth.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Try to pull strangers from the water
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The door is sealed. There is nothing to be done.

inside.title: Quarante Jours
inside.text:
L'arche tangue. Les animaux respirent.
Les jours se brouillent. Seul le craquement du bois demeure.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis 7:24 — Noah cared for his family and the animals through 150 days on the waters.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Sit alone and let despair grow
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The silence presses on you. Faith dims.

dove.title: La Colombe Revient
dove.text:
Tu libères une colombe. Les heures passent.
Elle revient — une feuille d'olivier dans son bec.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Even now, doubt fights to hold you.
[TODO:fr] Genesis 8:11 — The dove returned with an olive leaf — a sign of new life.

dry_land.title: La Terre Sous Tes Pieds
dry_land.text:
La porte s'ouvre. Le soleil inonde.
Tu marches sur une boue chaude et vivante.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Rush to claim the new land
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The land was never yours to claim.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Kneel and build an altar to God
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis 8:20 — Noah's first act on dry land was to build an altar to the Lord.

covenant.title: L'Arc-en-ciel
covenant.text:
Un arc-en-ciel traverse le ciel.
« Plus jamais. Ceci est mon alliance avec toi. »
